name: Duchi inside-sum Schatten-2 ratio for four PSD matrices
definition: For four complex Hermitian positive-semidefinite 3x3 matrices A1,...,A4, minimize the mean Frobenius norm of all 4^4 ordered products divided by the mean Frobenius norm of the 4! products that use each matrix exactly once.
solution_format: An object with matrices: four 3x3 complex matrices. Each entry is [real,imaginary], and each component is an integer or an exact rational string.
constraints: There are exactly four matrices, each 3x3.
Each matrix is complex Hermitian positive semidefinite.
The norm is the Schatten 2 norm, equal to the Frobenius norm.
The numerator is the mean over all 4^4 ordered index tuples, with repetition allowed.
The denominator is the mean over the 4! ordered tuples containing every index once.
The denominator must be positive so the ratio is defined.

parameters.numerator: mean norm over 256 ordered products with replacement
parameters.denominator: mean norm over 24 ordered products without replacement

verification: Parse every matrix entry as an exact rational complex number, verify Hermitian symmetry and all principal minors exactly, form all products exactly, and enclose each Frobenius norm with rational square-root bounds. Return the upper endpoint for minimization.

source_review.definition: Fixedn=m4,d3 complex Hermitian PSD matrices, minimize mean of256 Frobenius product norms divided by mean of24 distinct-index product norms; positive denominator. Norm is inside each summation. Rational Hermitian matrices with positive-definite perturbations preserve infimum.
source_review.primary_source: AlphaEvolve2511.02864v1 section6.47 explicitly states m>=4 open and lists(4,4,3) and Schatten2 tests. Duchi2012 inside-sum variant and Israel/Krahmer/Ward2016 proof for3 distinguished from RechtRe outside-sum counterexamples and2026 outside-sum claims.
source_review.human_and_reference: Four identity matrices give exact1 by the traditional equality case explicitly stated in primary source. This is a feasible upper bound on the infimum, not a proved minimum. Failed AI searches in source are not optimality evidence.
source_review.independent_method: Root Symbolic SymPy matrices independently verify all principal minors, every ordered product, and trace(M.H*M). Finer rational root enclosures certify every interval. Additional unequal diagonal and noncommuting complex fixtures give ratios about1.19204425349 and1.25270204220; both checked independently, recorded under runs/sol_additional_noncommuting_20261106.json.
source_review.admission: All five entries attain1, identity ratios cancel exactly. Root reruns all required strict controls, invalid negative minor, full-return claim invariance, saved replay, cold export, and program-error/nonfinite/timeout. Checker has no arbitrary coefficient-precision cap.
